shots.description: Wide two-shot: traveler steps up to a Seoul pharmacy counter, hand at her throat, as the pharmacist looks up.
Traveler gestures at her throat, phone glowing, asks in English: "Do you have something for a sore throat?"
shots.speaker: traveler

shots.description: Pharmacist nods, replies in Korean: "네, 이 목캔디랑 이 약을 추천해요."
shots.speaker: local

shots.description: Pharmacist sets medicine and throat candy on the counter; traveler smiles, reaching for them.

translations.source_transcript: Do you have something for a sore throat?
translations.output_transcript: 그러니까 우리 목 아플 때 쓸 거 있나요?
Yes, I recommend this throat candy and this medicine.

notes: EN->KO translation of "Do you have something for a sore throat?" needed 5 attempts: gpt-realtime-translate repeatedly mistranslated the concept (bronchitis, complexion, dry cough) before landing on a correct rendering. This looks like a genuine, reproducible model weakness for this phrase, not a one-off glitch -- worth flagging for the app's own translation-quality backlog. The local->EN reply also needed a retry after one run returned only 400ms of truncated output audio for a full-sentence transcript.

shots.description: Wide two-shot: a foreign tourist browses a Kyoto souvenir shop as the shopkeeper (the operator, holding the phone) looks on.
Tourist holds up a folded textile, asks in English: "Do you have this in a smaller size?"
shots.speaker: traveler

shots.description: Shopkeeper looks at his phone, then replies slowly and clearly in Japanese: "はい、こちらに小さいサイズがございます。" (regenerated twice: once to fix the customer's ethnicity/role — v1 read as an ambiguous local, not a foreign tourist — and once more with a slower, clearly-enunciated line after the first take's dialogue audio was too indistinct for the transcription model to hear "小さい" correctly).
shots.speaker: local

shots.description: Shopkeeper sets down a smaller folded textile; tourist smiles, picking it up to compare.

translations.source_transcript: Do you have this in a smaller size?
translations.output_transcript: さて、これの小さいサイズはありますか?

translations.source_transcript: はい。こちらに小さいサイズがございます。
translations.output_transcript: Yes, over here, there's a small size.

notes: Regenerated twice: v1's customer read as an ambiguous local rather than a clearly foreign tourist (QC reject on role/ethnicity clarity) -- fixed with an explicit Western-appearance description. The shopkeeper's JA line was then regenerated a third time with slow, clearly-enunciated phrasing after the first take's audio was too indistinct for gpt-4o-mini-transcribe to hear "chiisai" correctly (it heard "shai"), which silently dropped 'small' from the translation.

openai_spend_this_production_run.note: Sum of totalElapsedMs across every translate_audio.mjs call that produced a KEPT file (14 calls: 2 directions x 7 stories).
